coordinate_system.authored: x east, z south, map bounds [0,80]

navigation_philosophy.legible: Public routes visibly identify district destinations and remain usable without unlocking hidden connections.
navigation_philosophy.discoverable: Interior and elevated routes offer alternative choices; each has a building-specific entrance, floor, and credible destination.
navigation_philosophy.not_aimed_at: Not designed to imitate real-world tactical movement; all routes are fictional gameplay circulation.

structural_issues.problem: C01 original solid C-1 mass blocks new public arcade
structural_issues.resolution: explicit ground void, properly supported upper spans, entrances aligned at both ends
split north T02 and south T03 while reserving continuous elevated railway

structural_issues.problem: ST-01 east leg intersects A01 shell
structural_issues.resolution: ground-level service portal and load-bearing span above it

structural_issues.problem: Public and staff 8m rises currently behave as steep straight ramps
structural_issues.resolution: T05/T06 return stairs with landings at y3/5/7, access lift concept
structural_issues.verify: player physics stair-step and route graph

structural_issues.resolution: surface transitions and public ramps/stairs at identified edges

structural_issues.problem: Current southern boundary masks city continuation
structural_issues.resolution: keep boundary during stage2; create gateway only after playable expansion

structural_issues.problem: New low workshop overlaps old U1 path in plan
structural_issues.resolution: set roof precisely at y5 and make U1 walk on roof instead of passing through solid mass

structural_issues.problem: Existing Axiom interior mostly void without meaningful floor circulation
structural_issues.resolution: split ground lobby, service threshold, mezzanine ring, and closed offices

structural_issues.problem: Shop-through is only meaningful if continuous walkable interior exists between two door openings; legacy carves do not certify room geometry
structural_issues.resolution: Carve M03 using actual room and doorway footprint with clear headroom; connect to street and plaza transitions
structural_issues.verify: AABB solid intersection + walking simulation + door threshold sweep

structural_issues.problem: P01-E (+0) and P02-W (+1) share exactly the same x/z coordinate but different floor elevations
structural_issues.resolution: Move the raised gallery threshold inside the parcel and add a small multi-step entry or a separate gentler public route
structural_issues.verify: portal landing separation, continuous floor colliders, grade transition

structural_issues.problem: P02 gallery +5 U2 link has no individually modelled landings, bridge supports, or unbroken floor
structural_issues.resolution: Reserve exact cross-building bridge opening, supported slab and upper threshold, aligned at y=5
structural_issues.verify: no collision overlap; bridge support, human-readable entrance

structural_issues.problem: S1 S2 S3 stair IDs only represent vertical connectivity; detailed flights, headroom, landing room and render/collision synchronization are absent
structural_issues.resolution: Draw actual switchback/straight segments by named building before implementation, including top and bottom door clearances
structural_issues.verify: stairs are physically traversed in both game engines at walk, sprint and jump

structural_issues.problem: Two proposed 6x6m station stair footprints appear plausible but are not space-proven for actual landings, support and clearance
structural_issues.resolution: Fit exact multi-flight stair section inside each footprint or enlarge before greybox
structural_issues.verify: section fit, 3-D volume overlap tests, stair traversal

structural_issues.problem: Stage 2 upper graph can incorrectly imply an ordinary walkway spans the +5m to +9m difference
structural_issues.resolution: Replace elevation changes on U3/U4 with explicit stair connections; horizontal bridges only at matched levels
structural_issues.verify: all graph elevation changes typed vertical, never a flat edge with unequal y

change_policy: No live source changes, no direct replacement of published paths; design requires 3D greybox and engine testing.
